title: Bug when renaming a .tscn to .scn
body: ### Tested versions v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439] ### System information not relevant ### Issue description Hi, I am using goshapes, and they are saving scenes as text scenes (.tscn), which seem to be causing some problems because it's quite heavy. I've started receiving this error: The text-based scene at path "res://3D/prefabs/islands/Island1.tscn" is large on disk (4.93 MiB), likely because it has embedded binary data. This slows down scene saving and loading. Consider saving its binary subresource(s) to a binary `.res` file or saving the scene as a binary `.scn` file. This warning can be disabled in the Editor Settings (FileSystem > On Save > Warn on Saving Large Text Resources). So I tried to change the scene type. But it seem to: * fail if it is used in another scene * ~~succeed if it's not used~~ ~~So I can duplicate it, rename it, remove the old scene, add the new scene, delete the old scene.~~ I thought it would work, it does not seem to be working actually. I guess I can copy all the nodes in a new .scn scene. But I think it's still a problem. I've tried to look up how to change the scene type, and I have not found anything, so I'm assuming this is the write way, either way, I would expect Godot to indicates the right way to do it, or to succeed. When you do it, this is the first error you get: Then I tried to save, and I think it duplicate the scene, because I had the same old error. Then the main scene would not load: And it did duplicated the scene without asking me in which file to save it (ctrl+s), which maybe is another problem: When I rename it back, I can open the main scene containing it again. Also, the documentation does not have a page for .scn it seems, I only see https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/engine_details/file_formats/tscn.html If I did not miss something: 1. the documentation could be better 2. the error should indicates the proper states to resolve the issue (maybe) 3. I think Godot should prompt where to save the fake (?) scene again 4. the bug should not occur ### Steps to reproduce - Try to rename SampleIsland1.tscn to SampleIsland1.scn ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) https://github.com/solodeveloping/test-goshapes-bug-1
